purpose: Test whether model probability outputs behave like real event frequencies before changing the strict 0.40 control or promoting any practical-frequency challenger.
questions: When top1 probability is reported near a given level, does the predicted top1 actually win at a similar frequency?
When the frozen 3renhuku ticket probability is reported near a given level, does that exact unordered top3 ticket actually hit at a similar frequency?

required_inputs.prediction_side: already-produced pre-result model probabilities with stable race identity
required_inputs.label_side: result labels from an already-consumed and explicitly allowed dataset only

known_input_limitation.consequence: The Stage1 probability catalog alone cannot establish calibration because it intentionally lacks outcome labels.

stability: venue/class strata where sample size permits

bucket_policy.primary: fixed-width 0.10 probability bands where sample size is sufficient
bucket_policy.fallback: merge adjacent bands when counts are too small; do not interpret tiny bins as evidence
